name: scottiebosh
caption:
ONE LEFT. ONE STAYED. 🎮🏀 Chris Bosh was our No. 4 pick and left us for Miami. Scottie Barnes was our No. 4 pick and stayed.

• Bosh at 24 (2008-09): 22.7 PPG, 10.0 RPG, 0.9 SPG, 1.0 BPG, All-Star
• Scottie at 24 (2025-26): 18.1 PPG, 7.5 RPG, 5.9 APG, 1.4 SPG, 1.5 BPG, All-Star
• Scottie now, first 8 games: 23.5 PPG
• Bosh signed with Miami in 2010

Bosh at 24 or Scottie at 24? 👇

beats.head: ONE LEFT. ONE STAYED.
beats.name: BOSH
beats.vo: Two number four picks. Chris Bosh left us for Miami. Scottie Barnes stayed.

beats.head: BOSH AT 24
beats.name: BOSH
beats.vo: Bosh at twenty-four: twenty-two point seven points and ten rebounds a night. An All-Star.

beats.head: SCOTTIE AT 24
beats.name: SCOTTIE
beats.vo: Scottie at twenty-four, last season: eighteen points, seven and a half rebounds, almost six assists. Also an All-Star.

beats.head: THE DEFENSE
beats.name: SCOTTIE
beats.vo: Bosh scored more. Scottie did more: more steals, more blocks, more than double the assists.

beats.head: THIS SEASON
beats.name: SCOTTIE
beats.vo: And now, through his first eight games? Scottie is up to twenty-three point five a night.

beats.head: WHO'S BETTER?
beats.vo: Bosh at twenty-four, or Scottie at twenty-four? Comment below.

facts.claim: Bosh (born March 24, 1984) was selected fourth overall (#4) by Toronto in the 2003 draft, played for Toronto 2003-2010 and joined the Miami Heat in 2010; All-Star 2006-2016, so an All-Star in 2009 at age 24 (2008-09 season)
Barnes (born August 1, 2001) was the fourth overall (#4) pick in 2021; All-Star in 2024 and 2026, so an All-Star at age 24 in the 2025-26 season
